label: neiso 72 hy window
definition: neiso-72 KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-31, was 2026-07-31-neiso-71-nucavail): the neiso-71 keeper recipe with ONE structural delta -- constants.EIA930_PS_SPLIT_COMPLETE_FROM = {'NEISO': 2025}, which makes data.hydro.eia930_wat_level_folded refuse the EIA-930 NG:WAT monthly hydro LEVEL pin per-year for any backcast year before NEISO's first wholly-split calendar year (first filed NG:PS hour 2024-11-07) -- design D, a whole-year basis rule, never a mid-year splice. The pre-split NG:WAT series folds in ~1.9 TWh/yr of pumped-storage gross discharge (measured four independent ways); 2023/2024 hydro levels move to the units' own EIA-923 HY filings (builder budgets 8.5762/6.7144 TWh vs the 8.7750/7.3942 TWh NG:WAT-pinned basis), while 2025 -- the first wholly-split year -- keeps the pin and is BIT-IDENTICAL to the control (class_hourly/system/storage sidecars .equals=True). Zero fitted scalars (the refusal REMOVES a mechanism rather than adding one); scored against same-HEAD control 2026-07-31-neiso-72-control (neiso72_control_A, HEAD 10c624e), which reproduces the neiso-71 keeper to 4 decimals. Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, every criterion identical to the outgoing neiso-71 keeper: 6 PASS (C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6), C3c price-tail CAVEAT ledgered (model 0h vs RT actual 15h/2023 and 20h/2025, >$300 -- accepted measured-input limitation, 2026-07-11 frontier), C7 shape SKIPPED, C1 all 12/12 / free 8/8 (results/calibration/PREREG-neiso72-hydro-ps-window-2026-07-31.md).
